lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill region, with cluster spacing increasing along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity reflectance above to lower-intensity shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density arrangement of smaller high-luminance spots along its leading edge and dorsal surface.
